Class Room

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.rooms.Room
All Implemented Interfaces:
Disconnectable, Serializable, Remote
Direct Known Subclasses:
PlayingRoom, WaitingRoom
public abstract class Room extends Object implements Disconnectable, Serializable
The Room class represents an abstract base concept for any game room within the application. It manages the fundamental properties shared by all rooms, such as the room's name, its maximum capacity, and the list of currently connected players. Implementing classes (e.g., WaitingRoom, PlayingRoom) must define specific behaviors for entering the room and generating its mockup.

    • Room

      public Room(ServerMultiplexer server, Hall hall, String roomName, int maxNumOfPlayers)
      Constructs a new, empty Room.
      Parameters:
      server - the main server multiplexer managing the connections.

    • Room

      public Room(ServerMultiplexer server, Hall hall, String roomName, int maxNumOfPlayers, List<PhasedProxyPlayer> players)
      Constructs a Room and pre-fills it with an existing list of players. This is particularly useful when converting a WaitingRoom into a PlayingRoom.
      Parameters:
      server - the main server multiplexer managing the connections.
      hall - the main hall that spawned this room.
      roomName - the unique identifier/name of this room.
      maxNumOfPlayers - the maximum capacity of the room.
      players - the initial list of players to migrate into this room.

    • giveMockupRoom

      public abstract MockupRoom giveMockupRoom()
      Generates a lightweight, serializable representation (Mockup) of this room state.
      Returns:

    • broadcastMockupRoom

      protected void broadcastMockupRoom() throws Exception
      Broadcasts the current room state (as a Mockup) to all players inside. If a transmission to a specific player fails, that player is forcefully disconnected.
      Throws:
      Exception - if a critical network error disrupts the entire broadcasting process.

    • setServer

      public void setServer(ServerMultiplexer server)
      Sets or restores the server reference for this room. Essential for restoring the room's capabilities after a server state recovery (since the server reference is transient).
      Parameters:
      server - the new ServerMultiplexer to inject.
